findings.description: CHECKED_PATHS named Markdown documents as :(glob)*.md, which matches the repository root alone, while the link check reads every Markdown document git tracks; a pull request changing a document in a directory the set names no other way, such as .github/ or config/, was reported as not checked although a check reads it, contradicting the workflow's statement that the set holds every path a check reads. The entry is now :(glob)**/*.md.
